description: This file is a PHP script for the Upgrade Wizard module in SuiteCRM, handling layout merge and rollback operations during the upgrade process. It includes functions for cleaning merge data, rolling back file changes, and formatting layout data for display, as well as main logic for processing user input and updating the user interface.

methods.name: cleanMergeData
methods.description: Removes empty or invalid layout entries from the merge data array to prepare data for user confirmation display.

methods.name: rollBackMergedModules
methods.description: Iterates over specified modules and rolls back merged layout files by restoring backups.

methods.name: formatLayoutMergeDataForDisplay
methods.description: Formats raw layout merge data into a structure suitable for display in the user interface, including labeling different layout types.
